component.name: Road Fighter
component.summary: Unofficial remake of Konami's Road Fighter

description.p: Road Fighter Remake is an unofficial, not-for-profit remake of Konami's ROAD FIGHTER, originally released in 1985 for the MSX home computer systems. Dodge traffic, manage your fuel, and race to the finish line across six stages, alone or with a friend in split-screen.
SDL3 port of the Road Fighter remake.

ul.li: Gamepad support for up to two players
Options for music and sound effects volume, fullscreen, 2D filters and each player's input device
2D upscaling filters: Scale2x, 2xSaI, hq2x, xBR, OmniScale and Lanczos
The game scales to the window, which can be resized
Revised credits and several bug fixes
